$description: The command bar’s find-and-view panels (platform/patterns/CommandBar/find-panel.css: FilterPanel, SortPanel, GroupPanel, ColumnsMenu and ManageColumnsDialog, QuickFilter): one row geometry for every panel (owner, 2026-10-14: the Filter, Sort and Group panels share it), the pickers’ widths, the value pills in their category colors and the Columns list.

find-panel-min-width.$description: Filter, Sort and Group panel: the narrowest the panel is (its rows fit their field, direction or operator and value).

find-panel-gap.$description: A panel: the space between its head, its rows and its Add buttons.

find-panel-head-gap.$description: A panel head: the space between the title row and the line under it.

find-panel-title-gap.$description: A panel head: the space between the title and its info button.

find-panel-actions-gap.$description: A panel head: the space between its actions (Collapse all, Expand all).

find-panel-rows-gap.$description: A panel’s rows: the space between two rows.

find-panel-row-gap.$description: A panel row: the space between its controls (the same in the three panels).

find-panel-row-radius.$description: A panel row: its corners (its focus outline and its drag image).

find-panel-row-dragging-opacity.$description: A panel row while it is dragged.

find-panel-frame-border-color.$description: The Filter panel’s conditions: the frame around them (and around a condition group).

find-panel-frame-border-width.$description: The Filter panel’s conditions: the frame’s width.

find-panel-frame-radius.$description: The Filter panel’s conditions: the frame’s corners.

find-panel-frame-padding.$description: The Filter panel’s conditions: the space inside the frame.

find-panel-nested-background.$description: A condition group inside the Filter panel: the sunken surface sets it apart.

find-panel-join-width.$description: The Filter panel: the join column (Where, and, or), the same in every row.

find-panel-add-gap.$description: A panel: the space between its Add buttons.

find-panel-handle-text.$description: A panel row and a Columns row: the drag handle.

find-panel-placeholder-text.$description: A multi-select with nothing chosen: its placeholder ("Choose options").

find-panel-pick-field-width.$description: A panel row: the field picker (its type icon and name).

find-panel-pick-dir-width.$description: A panel row: the direction or order picker (A → Z, Oldest → newest).

find-panel-pick-op-width.$description: A Filter row: the operator picker (is any of, contains).

find-panel-pick-value-width.$description: A Filter row: the value (a text, a number, a date or the chosen options).

find-panel-pick-join-width.$description: A Filter row: the and / or picker of the second row (its word and the chevron).

find-panel-pills-gap.$description: A multi-select: the space between its pills.

find-panel-pill-radius.$description: A value pill: the badge’s corners.

find-panel-pill-border-width.$description: A value pill: its 1px border, in the category color (the pill border rule for category colors is still open with the owner).

find-panel-pill-font-size.$description: A value pill: its text size.

find-panel-pill-font-weight.$description: A value pill: its text weight.

find-panel-pill-padding-inline.$description: A value pill: the space beside its text.

find-panel-checklist-gap.$description: A quick filter’s checklist: the space between its values.

find-panel-range-gap.$description: The Date quick filter: the space between From and To.

find-panel-frame-background.$description: A panel drawn open (inline): the popover’s surface.

find-panel-frame-outer-radius.$description: A panel drawn open (inline): the popover’s corners.

find-panel-frame-outer-padding.$description: A panel drawn open (inline): the popover’s padding.

columns-list-gap.$description: The Columns list: the space between its rows.

columns-list-row-gap.$description: A Columns row: the space between its handle, checkbox, Make first column and the moves.

columns-list-row-padding.$description: A Columns row: the space around it (its hover fill).

columns-list-name-min-width.$description: A Columns row: the narrowest its name gets.

columns-list-first-text.$description: A Columns row: the first column’s mark (pin and "First column").

columns-list-first-gap.$description: A Columns row: the space between the pin and "First column".

find-panel-focus-color.$description: A focused panel row or Columns row: its focus outline (a row is not a field: it takes the focus ring).

find-panel-focus-width.$description: A focused panel row or Columns row: the outline’s width.

find-panel-focus-offset.$description: A focused panel row or Columns row: the outline’s offset.
